title: Are these grades right?
intro: 10 real picks from Steps days already played, recent players only. Each step is shown as in the game: think who you would name, then tap the gap to see a pick and the grade the game gives it. Say whether it should be higher (a deeper cut than that), lower (more obvious than that), or is right. A note is optional.

options.hint: Deeper than that: it deserves a higher grade
